user.title: NMA Mobile Credentials
user.description:
Connect to the NMA API. Use the development URL while testing.

Choose whether personal information comes into Home Assistant. Unticked, you only get the overall health of the NMA API: company status, ACS WebSocket and API reachability.

data_description.personal_data: Names, e-mail addresses, people and credential counts, per-person and per-credential entities, and company contacts. Leave unticked for health only.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the NMA API.
error.company_not_found: No company with that ID exists at this endpoint (404).
error.rate_limited: Rate limit hit (429). The API allows 30 requests/minute across all endpoints — wait a minute and try again.
error.server_unavailable: The API gateway returned 502/503/504. The backend is unreachable or temporarily down — check the URL and that the API is up.
error.invalid_url: Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_company_id: Company ID must be a valid UUID.

abort.already_configured: This (base URL, company ID) is already configured.

init.title: NMA options
init.description: Untick personal information for health only (company status, ACS WebSocket, API reachability). The fetch toggles fine-tune what is fetched when personal information is on.

data_description.personal_data: Unticked = health only: no /people or /credentials calls, and people/credential entities are removed. The two fetch toggles below only apply when this is ticked.

refresh.name: Refresh NMA data
refresh.description: Force-refresh one or all NMA config entries.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional NMA config entry ID. If omitted, every NMA entry is refreshed.
